name: Alma Adams
summary:
Alma Shealey Adams (born May 27, 1946) is an American politician who represents North Carolina's 12th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives. A Democrat, Adams represented the state's 58th House district in Guilford County in the North Carolina General Assembly from her appointment in April 1994 until her election to Congress, succeeded by Ralph C. Johnson. Adams will become the dean of North Carolina's congressional delegation beginning in 2027, following the defeats of Virginia Foxx and Richard Hudson
Adams is a former college administrator and art professor from Greensboro.
